scope: One single-worker diagnostic with forced GC, live histograms and sequential NMT/smaps snapshots every 100 actual reloads. Timing is not performance evidence. NMT committed bytes are not resident bytes; unmatched anonymous regions include JVM malloc, allocator free pages and third-party allocations. Live-loader counts establish collectibility at checkpoints, not natural collection timing or unbounded lifetime stability. Five-second native trimming remains active during diagnostics.
